profile.visual_desc: Amorphous shadowy figure with a dark, murky silhouette. Features piercing, horizontally-aligned glowing white eyes. No visible armor or gear, appearing as a fluid, spectral entity.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Dramatic close-up of narrow, intense glowing white eyes against a deep blue void. Expression is cold and enigmatic.
profile.weapon_desc: Tri-pronged energy claws manifested from the entity's form.
profile.step1_ready: Stance at top-left facing down-right. Faint golden energy begins to coalesce where limbs would be.
profile.step2_windup: Energy arcs pull back toward the upper-left, intensifying in brightness and forming three distinct streaks.
profile.step3_impact: Full extension of three parallel golden energy slashes striking diagonally down-right. High-contrast yellow and white light.
profile.step4_finish: Golden energy trails shorten and dissolve into small sparks as the entity settles back into shadow.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arcs in Frame 4 strictly follow a 45-degree downward-right diagonal trajectory consistent with the strike direction.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains perspective and claw consistency. VFX timing and diagonal trajectory align with reference.
